name_reason: Name is compliant and accurate. Form data_fd2_battle_<descriptor> matches the global naming rule for a battle-core runtime structure. The descriptor 'runtime_char_array_ptr' correctly reflects both the purpose (the active runtime character array) and the data type (a pointer). Confirmed by Ghidra datatype 'runtime_char *' and by all access patterns: writers (0x102c3 fd2_load_save_and_init_engine, 0x109db fd2_load_chapter_battle_data, plus the chapter_transition (re)assignments) store malloc(0x1e00) results; the 100+ readers index it as ptr[idx].field of a 0x50-byte runtime_char. No Ghidra address residue in the name (no hex suffix equal to its own/any address).
purpose: Single global indirection pointer to the active per-chapter runtime character array (runtime_char[], each entry 0x50/80 bytes); the canonical handle through which the entire battle/field/menu engine accesses party members and battle-chapter enemy units.
logic_summary: BSS pointer, NULL at program start. (Re)allocated via NULL-guarded free + malloc(0x1e00) (=7680B = 96 entries x 0x50) on chapter load (fd2_load_chapter_battle_data) and save restore (fd2_load_save_and_init_engine); the loader memmoves party_member_count * 0x50 bytes of character records into it. Freed and reset to NULL on chapter transition (fd2_chapter_transition_menu, fd2_chapter_transition_with_intro). During the battle-chapter recruitment screen the pointer is transiently aliased to data_fd2_shared_menu_party_roster_buffer_ptr (the same runtime_char-shaped menu roster buffer) and then reset to NULL. Read by 100+ functions across battle AI, rendering, menus, dialog, animation, chapter init/end and event handlers, always as ptr[char_idx].field.
element_semantics: Pointer to the first element of a runtime_char[] array. Each pointed-to element is an 80-byte (0x50) per-character runtime struct (position bPos_x/bPos_y, sprite_state[], bTeam, bPortrait_id, bFlags, status flags block, combat aux block, HP/MP/AP/DP/level/inventory etc.; see KB runtime_char layout). Array capacity is 96 (0x1e00/0x50); live entry count per chapter is party_member_count.
